qa_pairs.question: Where is the motor relay located in the BMW E30 M3?
qa_pairs.answer: The motor relay is located in the center of the windshield header, as shown in Figure 1.

qa_pairs.question: What component is located below the rear of the center console?
qa_pairs.answer: The park brake switch is located below the rear of the center console, as shown in Figure 3.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find the cruise control unit in the E30 M3?
qa_pairs.answer: The cruise control unit is located behind the right-hand side of the dash, as shown in Figure 5.

qa_pairs.question: What is the reference number for the power window circuit breaker shown in Figure 2?
qa_pairs.answer: The power window circuit breaker has reference number C301, as shown in Figure 2.

qa_pairs.question: Which components are visible behind the RH side of the dash in Figure 4?
qa_pairs.answer: Behind the RH side of the dash in Figure 4, you can see components C107 and G103.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the auto-charging flashlight connector located?
qa_pairs.answer: The auto-charging flashlight connector is located on the left-hand side of the glove box, as shown in Figure 6.

qa_pairs.question: What is the sunroof motor reference number shown in the component location views?
qa_pairs.answer: The sunroof motor has reference number G600, as shown in Figure 1.

qa_pairs.question: Besides the cruise control unit, what other component is shown behind the RH side of dash in Figure 5?
qa_pairs.answer: Besides the cruise control unit, the Motronic control unit and glove box light switch are also shown behind the RH side of dash in Figure 5.
